text:
Hello all, 

For context, I am currently in Israel on a student visa, just finished my studies, trying to switch to a b1. Our office is Ramat Gan. Me and my boyfriend got our interview date for January 2027 with a document handover meeting in july.

Aside from that being a lot of time, I've read here that the office can give me a multiple entries visa along with the b2 but it's not guaranteed. Does anyone else have experience with far out interview dates and being given a multiple entries visa for the inter period? 6 months is just simply a lot of time for me not to be able to visit my family or travel at all. 

To those that got the inter visa, what are the conditions of it?
